pins.title: Pergola Lighting Ideas for an Outdoor Room After Dark
pins.description: A pergola feels like a whole new outdoor room when the lighting is layered thoughtfully. Explore warm integrated LEDs, softly glowing canopy lights and surrounding garden uplighting in Veluce's practical pergola lighting guide.

pins.title: Outdoor Lighting Glare: Plan the View From Your Seating First
pins.description: Do garden lights look inviting until you sit down and face a bare bulb? Check the view from your seating before choosing fixtures. Veluce Studio’s Outdoor Lighting Blueprint includes glare decision cards, the 4-Axis Nightscape System and a fixture scorecard to help you plan the effect before shopping. Explore the complete digital outdoor lighting planning system.

pins.title: Patio Layout Planning: Leave Room to Walk Around the Furniture
pins.description: Does your patio look inviting but feel awkward to walk through? Plan a clear route from the doors before arranging seating and dining furniture. Veluce Studio’s Luxury Outdoor Room Planner uses the 5-Layer Outdoor Room Method, layout recipes and planning tools to help balance purpose, zones, flow and furniture scale. Explore the complete digital outdoor room planner.

pins.title: Interior Design Brief: Name What Isn’t Working Before Choosing a Style
pins.description: Does a room look appealing yet still frustrate the way you live? Record the pinch points, measurements, must-keeps and daily routines before discussing style. Veluce Studio’s Designer Brief Builder uses the CLEAR Method to turn real-space facts, lifestyle needs, priorities, aesthetic signals and constraints into a usable project brief. Explore the complete digital briefing system.

pins.title: Bedroom Lighting Ideas: Let the Ceiling Rest and Layer the Light
pins.description: Does your bedroom feel harsh when the ceiling light is on and too dim when it is off? Layer a soft headboard glow, a focused bedside lamp, gentle wall wash and low circulation light instead of relying on one overhead source. Veluce Studio’s Luxury Lighting Formula uses the Seven Signals—hierarchy, layers, direction, warmth, shadow, concealment and scenes—to help plan controlled lighting changes before buying. Explore the complete digital lighting system.

pins.title: Furniture Sizing: Check the Fit Before You Order the Sofa
pins.description: Does the sofa fit on paper but leave no comfortable route through the room? Mark its real footprint and circulation clearance before ordering, then compare the specification against your plan. Veluce Studio’s Room Procurement System uses the SOURCE Method to help homeowners specify before shopping, compare evidence, verify cost and fit, and track purchases through delivery and close-out. Explore the complete digital procurement system.

pins.title: Whole-Home Color Palette: Make Every Room Feel Related, Not Repeated
pins.description: Do your rooms look individually finished but unrelated when you move through the house? Define one core palette of timber, stone, neutrals and accent colours, then vary its balance from room to room. Veluce Studio’s Complete Home Design System brings five specialist planning packs together with a master guide, whole-home workbook and decision gates for more cohesive choices. Explore the complete digital home design system.
